description: Source code for the FFExecutionContext class, which implements JavaScript execution context handling for Firefox in the Playwright project. It includes methods for evaluating expressions, retrieving properties, and managing object handles within a browser automation context.

classes.name: FFExecutionContext
classes.description: Implements JavaScript execution context delegate for Firefox, providing methods to evaluate scripts, get properties, and manage object handles within a browser session.

methods.name: rawEvaluateJSON
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript expression in the context and returns the result as JSON.

methods.name: rawEvaluateHandle
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript expression and returns a handle to the result.

methods.name: evaluateWithArguments
methods.description: Calls a function with arguments within the execution context, returning the result.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Retrieves properties of a JavaScript object handle.

methods.name: releaseHandle
methods.description: Releases a JavaScript handle to free resources.
